_about: The zap look (F67): what zapping goop looks like, in both goo styles (Jelly and Particle). Muzzy's pick from the sketch, 2026-10-24 ("great settings. Both." — research/zap-look/picks.json, sketch research/sketches/zap-look.html): the L5 laser + v1's spray together. A white beam from the top centre of the visible tank to your tap; the goop turns white-hot and swells for the first 40% of beamTime, then is sucked into the laser point (the side nearest your tap first, so it stretches into a teardrop) over suckTime; a spray of droplets in its colour once, at sprayAt. Looks only: the rules remove the cells at once. Reduce motion: no swell and no spray (the beam and the suck-in stay). Numbers only; keys starting with _ are notes.

_help.beamTime: Seconds the white beam shows, from the top centre of the tank down to your tap. The goop heats up (white-hot + swell) during the first 40% of it. 0 = no beam, no heat-up wait.
_help.whiteHot: How far the zapped goop turns toward white. 0 = keeps its colour, 1 = pure white-hot.
_help.swell: How much the zapped goop puffs up while it heats (0.2 = 20% bigger). Off with reduce motion.
_help.suckTime: Seconds to be sucked into the laser point; the side nearest your tap goes first, so it stretches into a teardrop. 0 = it just vanishes (v1).
_help.droplets: How many droplets spray out of each zap (0 = none). Off with reduce motion.
_help.dropSpeed: How fast the droplets fly out (v1 pixels per second on a 30-pixel cell; they scale with the tank).
_help.dropLife: Seconds a droplet lives (each one 70–130% of this) before it's gone.
_help.gravity: How fast the droplets fall (v1 pixels per second², on a 30-pixel cell).
_help.sprayAt: When the spray happens: 0 = the moment the beam hits, out of the whole goop; 1 = at the end, a burst out of the laser point.
